voice_list.text: Hmm, where should I go next?
Oh, I hear the minerals calling... I wonder where that sound is coming from?
I wonder if there's a recipe for a sweet treat that would really surprise everyone? Hmm...
Here you go! It's a Rock Cookie. Since it might break your teeth, let it dissolve in your mouth instead!
This basket is cute, but it doesn't hold much. I guess I'll just put some candy in it for now.
This scenery that stretches beyond... it seems almost otherworldly.
I must keep watch to ensure His Highness isn't led astray...
I wonder if this kind of outfit suits me...?
The defense is rather low, which concerns me... but I must admit it looks quite nice.
Would anyone even appreciate seeing a knight like me in such an outfit...?
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to investigate it thoroughly.
It's lively, but somehow calming. What a peculiar place.
There are so many beautiful girls here, I can't help but let my eyes wander.
Resna and Valeria... hehe, I might see something interesting here.
There are still truths to be uncovered by these eyes, it seems.
I'm not very good at cleaning up... I can hardly call myself a role model, I regret to say.
It's frustrating... I wish Resna would talk more with everyone else.
Hehe. We've welcomed a new year. Let's all start fresh, everyone~
This is my special outfit for the New Year's celebration. It suits me quite well, don't you think?
Someone like me can pull off any outfit. See? Even the way I move!
The construction of this atelier is truly praiseworthy. I would love to have something like this in my castle.
My, my... This is the first time I've seen this book. May I borrow it for a while?
As a queen, I chose an outfit both functional and elegant.
I must grow accustomed to new attire and new ways of fighting.
A ruler must act for their people and wield their authority wisely.
Well then, shall I help myself to one of these sweets?
This atelier itself might be proof of advanced alchemy.
This outfit, a symbol of friendship with Lara, is surprisingly easy to move in.
It's an elegant outfit, but I feel somewhat out of place wearing it in the atelier.
Lira's servant was looking at me like I was some rare beast. Surely this outfit isn't that strange...
I want to show everyone my atelier too!
I'm feeling inspired to try some new recipes. I wonder if I could borrow the cauldron?
I want to try some new alchemy... I wonder if anyone would like to help me?
It's not because I'm a genius that I can do this. I can do this because I'm me!
Hmm, I just can't get the ribbon angle right today. Maybe here? Or perhaps here...
Since we have time, maybe I should do some cleaning. There's a duster right here...
Everyone who gathers here is so unique. I bet they all have interesting stories to tell.
I used to be quite frail, but thanks to Marie, I've become much healthier.
I'm not sure if I'm being helpful... but I'll do my best to be useful!
This atelier is beautiful. I always thought alchemists were messy people.
It's impossible to get bored here.
There are so many different alchemists here. There's much to learn.
Being surrounded by so many alchemists... It really gets me fired up!
The possibilities of alchemy, and its dangers... There's no end to what we must consider.
Ahh. A quiet atelier brings peace to the heart...
All sorts of people gather here. I wonder if I'll make any friends?
There are so many books I've never seen before. Which one should I read first?
I should probably check our tool inventory soon.
Maybe I'll invite Riza to go shopping next time. We can do some market research too...
Traveling to new places is so much fun - there's always something new to discover!
I'm getting used to the scenery of this atelier. It's starting to feel like my second home.
I love this place because so many people gather here!
It's easy to forget, but these peaceful, uneventful days are truly precious.
Hmm! Nothing much happening today, so maybe I'll go adventuring somewhere far away~
Adventuring to unknown places is so exciting!
I wonder if they have any rabbit plushies?
I'm bored. Maybe I'll lie down for a nap.
Big sis is kind and strong. I really look up to her.
Today is peaceful with nothing special happening. Grateful for these tranquil days. A dance of gratitude! Yay~
Wherever big sis goes, I'll follow - be it to the bath or even a volcano!
I want to master all the recipes I've been taught! Should start by gathering materials first?
Ah~ I want to see all sorts of places in the outside world! Getting on a ship and going on a journey... the dreams are endless...!
Alright, today I'm going to try that new recipe they taught me earlier!
Maybe I should ask Bepp to teach me some close combat techniques next time...
A street stall that Resna used to run...? Sounds like she was doing something similar to what I do~
Ahh... Something about this place just helps me relax...
When I sit still like this, I can't help but think about my daughter.
Taking time to rest your body during breaks is also part of a holy knight's duty.
Maybe I should do some tidying up while I have the chance. Cleaning is one of my specialties, after all.
Mmm~! A good stretch always feels so nice.
Huh...? What was this herb supposed to do again...?
This atelier holds so many precious memories.
Whatever awaits at the end of this journey, I chose this path myself. I won't have any regrets.
Just wearing new clothes can really lift your spirits~!
I can't wait to see what we'll find in the new frontier~!
It's so relaxing here... Maybe I should take a nap.
Acting like a proper adult is the hardest thing to do.
There's still so much I don't understand, but I guess I just have to take it one step at a time.
I want to learn more. About all the things I don't know about myself.
Now then... what should I do? I'm getting kind of hungry.
Maybe I should digest some of these books I've been collecting.
Taking it easy once in a while isn't so bad...
I'm bored... Maybe I'll read a book...
I'm getting a little hungry...
Perhaps I should study some alchemy while I have the chance.
Waiting around for this long is starting to make me feel restless...
Until physical labor is needed, maybe I'll do some training.
Is there anything troubling you? If there's something I can help with, just call for me.
I should meditate. One must always be ready to act at a moment's notice.
I never skip my training. This too is for the sake of justice.
I don't have much to do right now... Maybe I'll do some knitting...?
Ugh... Reini hasn't abandoned me... right...?
I need to find something I can do for Reini while I have the chance...!
Since I have some time, maybe I should groom my fur...?
Mmm... What a perfect day for a nap...
Wow, there are so many fashionable people here! Maybe I should ask them about their style preferences.
I wonder if there are any materials or books I could use to make clothes? I should look around!
I just thought of a design for a new outfit! Better write it down before I forget!
Being alone for so long makes my mind wander to all sorts of things...
Hmm... nothing much to do, maybe I should do some cleaning.

Pretty decent equipment here.
Quite different from my hometown.
I'm bored... Maybe I'll go look for some requests.
Rather than searching for better paying jobs, it'd be faster if they just came to me with them.
Sigh... Why are they being so nice? I've got nothing to offer in return...
Wonder if there's anything good around here worth finding.
There's some delicious tea here. Should I sneak away and enjoy it?
I have plenty of time. Maybe I should give my gun some maintenance?
Ahh... I'm feeling rather sleepy today. At times like these, a nap is just what I need.
Now then, shall I go looking for something cute?
Time spent alone and time spent with cherished companions... both are equally precious.
From seniors to juniors, there are so many wonderful people here. I better not fall behind!
There are so many different kinds of materials used in alchemy...
I wonder where Ryza went? I wanted to chat with her.
I can't think of any new promotional ideas... Maybe I should ask Plachta for advice.
I want to meet more people to network with for my future career.
Time to review today's lessons.
Coming up with new recipes is always so much fun!
This business theory could be useful. I should report it to Klaudia later.
Tomorrow's schedule is... Perfect, everything's in order!
In this age of science, taking on the challenge of running a business using alchemy isn't such a bad idea.
Let's see, I need to prepare that next... I've got so much to do today!
Maybe I should take a little break. After all, rest is part of research too!
I've got a feeling something's going to happen at the academy today. I just hope it's nothing too crazy!
The secret to a peaceful academy life is greeting everyone cheerfully, no matter who they are!
Oh no, I forgot to prepare for the next class! That's not good, but maybe I should skip it...?
I need to procure some equipment... It's necessary for the next experiment.
Everyone seems so busy lately. Is there anything I can help with?
I'm truly grateful to be an exchange student at such a wonderful academy.
Is there anything troubling you? I'm sure I can be of assistance.
I want to make this academy life one where we all get along and stay cheerful together.

There are so many books about alchemy here.
It wouldn't hurt to study them a bit.
Mental work always makes me crave something sweet.
I must make full use of the experience I've gained studying at various schools.
Meeting expectations while pursuing my ideals... I believe that's both right and natural.

"Kitty Team"...
What a cute name... "Kitty"...

If I do this here... and that there...
Ah, I see! That's how it works...!

Hmm, got some time to kill...
Maybe I should do some light exercise.

It's so peaceful~ Since I have time,
maybe I'll do some hammer maintenance.

Ugh! There's way too much to remember about being a knight!
My head hurts!
As a knight, I have to make sure I properly guard Resna's atelier!
I need to stay alert even while waiting. Ready to move at a moment's notice.
I don't have much to do today... Maybe I'll pass the time reading a book.
I should ask Resna to teach me alchemy next time. I want to see just how far my talents can take me.
You know... these peaceful days aren't so bad after all. At least I can catch up on my reading.
It would be irresponsible to let a genius like me just waste away doing nothing.
So access to this place is restricted. Makes for a good spot to hide from enemies.
I'd like to dispose of these sweets... but if others are enjoying them, I should hold back.
This outfit is hard to get used to, but I've made some adjustments to move more freely.
This appears to be something worn during festivals.
Festivals and such... they were never part of my life before. But perhaps... they're not so bad.
There's something calming about being in an atelier.
Perhaps I should organize the materials.
Faster, sharper. My spear won't lose to anyone.
...Ah! I should make sure Totori hasn't gotten mixed up with any troublemakers. I'll go look for her.
I'll make my name known in this world too. I need to leave my mark properly.
Maybe I'll take a little nap.
Let's see, I put my tools over there...
Oh, it's almost snack time for my little hamsters.
I'd love to teach people everything I know about alchemy.
I should write down what I've learned before I forget it.
Which pie should I make for today's snack?
This isn't my atelier, so I need to make sure I don't blow anything up...
Ehehe. I wonder if I can be a little more ladylike today... if that's even possible...
With my charming appeal all dressed up, the cafe is sure to prosper! ...Or so I'd like to think.
Whoa... phew. I'm wearing such pretty clothes. I need to make sure I don't get them dirty!
Phew... Reading a book by myself is so relaxing. Right, Aona?
I should...do some cleaning...
Criselda and Resna... They said we get along well... but I'm still not comfortable around them.
Swimming in the sea... It looks like the Luarca are looking forward to it too.
Even if it's just swimwear, Aona and the others are with me.
This atelier's quality is truly commendable. I would love to have one like this in my castle.
Oh my... This is the first time I've seen this book. May I borrow it for a while?
I specially grant you permission to admire my beautiful swimsuit figure.
The Queen dons a swimsuit. This too shall be another page in the heroic saga.
Strong sunlight is my enemy. I must reapply sunscreen right away...
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to examine it more closely.
It's bustling, but somehow calming. What a mysterious place.
Since I'm wearing a swimsuit, I suppose I should go play in the water. Hehe.
I want to take a good look at everyone's swimsuits. Especially Rorolina Frixell's.
It's nice to see Antje having such a good time. These peaceful moments aren't so bad.
I can't let my guard down even while waiting. I need to be ready to move at a moment's notice.
Nothing to do today... Maybe I'll read a book to pass the time.
Resna said this swimsuit looks cute on me. Heh... It's so obvious that she doesn't need to say it.
This swimsuit's ease of movement is quite appealing. The defense is a bit thin, but that's not a problem!
Back when I was with the Moonlight Society, swimming for fun was naturally out of the question.
This is the wisdom of alchemy...! My heart races with excitement every time I visit!
I wonder if the day will come when I can understand these difficult texts...?
I am one who has received training in the ninja arts since childhood and pledges unwavering loyalty to my master.
To save my master, I would go through fire and water. That is my single-minded devotion.
The "alchemy" that Lady Alvina uses... What a mysterious and wonderful art it is!
Alchemy and onmyoji arts. While they're completely different systems, I can sense something that connects them.
The beauty of these foreign young ladies is quite remarkable... Each has their own unique charm that's hard to rank.
Onmyoji is an ancient official position in Keiun. It's popular because you can do all sorts of interesting things.
I was originally the second son of a warrior family. That's why I can handle a sword to some degree.
"Towa" is my professional name. My real name would be a bit too dignified for an onmyoji.
To share such knowledge so generously... Alchemists are truly magnanimous souls!
This is quite a comfortable place. I'm rather fond of it.
What an interesting place. I'd like to have something similar on my estate.
My wish is for the peace of Keiun's people. May Kaburaya broaden his perspective as a lord and continue to progress.
I understand the value of old things. However, avoiding the new and waiting for decay is the height of folly.
The power to understand and manipulate all phenomena in the world... Alchemy is quite fascinating indeed.
All the foreigners here are so graceful and strong. I wish I could become stronger too...
Um... I'm not very good at speaking... But I do enjoy listening to everyone's stories.
If Kaburaya-sama aims for distant horizons, then I will accompany her anywhere.
Kaburaya-sama is such an upright person. I must make sure I don't get left behind...
Phew. This place really is calming.
Sometimes I think it'd be a lot more fun if I could use alchemy.
These wanderers are such interesting folks. I never get bored around them.
Aw, my usual restaurant is closed. How am I gonna fill this empty stomach of mine...
I don't have anything to do, so I'm pretty bored. Maybe I should tag along with someone who's heading out.
Phew. This place really is calming.
Sometimes I think it'd be a lot more fun if I could use alchemy.
These wanderers are such interesting folks. I never get bored around them.
Aw, my usual restaurant is closed. How am I gonna fill this empty stomach of mine...
I don't have anything to do, so I'm pretty bored. Maybe I should tag along with someone who's heading out.
Hmm. Sometimes it's not so bad to forget about my mission and just take a nice, long rest.
Alchemy is always such a wonderful sight to behold! How about it? If you need any help, I'm more than ready to lend a hand!
I hope Nady isn't going hungry. Maybe I should whip up one of my home-cooked meals for her...
This space that Mother created... it has the same sense of security as our own home, doesn't it?
Oh! Today's meal is delicious too! I'm truly grateful! Thank you! Thank you!
Ahh, I still want to play some more!
Staying up late is... bad for your skin...
Well then, another day ahead... Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.
Sometimes it's nice to just relax in your room too.
Phew... Maybe I should go to bed for today...
Huh...? What kind of effects did this herb have again...?
This atelier is filled with so many different memories.
Does this swimsuit suit me? It's a l-little... daring... maybe?
Everyone at Venus looks so beautiful... Do I look a bit more grown-up too?
A festival where you exercise in swimsuits and compete in beauty... It would be fun if it became a new Lantarna tradition.
What should I have for dessert today...?
Hmm... Is it time for snacks yet...? Not yet... not yet...
Aaah... This feels so nice I could fall asleep.
Hehe, I haven't had nearly enough fun yet!
Hmm... Is it time for snacks yet...? Not yet... not yet...
I want to master all the recipes I was taught! First, I should start gathering materials, right?
Ahh, I want to see all sorts of outside worlds! Getting on a ship and going on a journey... My dreams are expanding...!
Hehe! How about it, Alvi's swimsuit look! Feel free to admire me from the front and from the back!
Strong and beautiful! Cute! Dazzling!! Do you like Alvi like this?
A dazzling sky, a vast ocean! A cute swimsuit! At this rate, I have no choice but to spread my wings, right?
Carrying out the assigned requests is the role of the Moonlight Society. Those who fail to do so have no place in the Society.
People only bow before fear.
I don't jest. Do you want to have your tongue pulled out?
Royalty are nothing but a gathering of corrupt fools.
Those who disturb the Society's order will be eliminated by me.
...I've read almost all the books around here. Not that I can use alchemy, though.
I've found myself with a gap in my schedule... Now then, what should I do to fill the time?
These glasses are my important partner in handling intellectual matters. I must clean them properly.
It's good that everyone is enthusiastic, but... are you all getting proper sleep?
An organized and tidy space is more important than anything. Otherwise, my thoughts become scattered.
Coming here makes me feel like I could have some delicious tea and sweets.
Wanderers are so interesting! I'd love to hear more about their original worlds and other stories.
When you have interesting things happening, every day shines brightly. I wonder what'll happen today?
I'm actually quite the capable merchant, you know. Gathering information is my specialty!
Alvina always reacts so earnestly, so it's really fun to tease her~
Hmm. It's not so bad to forget about my duties once in a while and take a nice, relaxing break.
Alchemy is always so wonderful to watch! Hey, I'm pretty handy if you need help!
I wonder if Nana's gotten hungry. Perhaps I should whip up one of my special dishes for her...
This space that Mother created... It has the same sense of security as our home, doesn't it?
Oh! Today's meal was delicious, too! I must express my gratitude! Thank you! Thank you!
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to investigate it more thoroughly.
It's lively, yet somehow calming. What a mysterious place.
...Hehe. I quite like this outfit. Though I wouldn't mind if it were a bit more daring.
Antje's outfit is adorable too. Since we have the chance, I'd love to see the other girls try them on as well.
Dressing like this makes me feel like new doors are opening. Not a bad experience at all.
Phew... Reading a book by myself is so relaxing. Right, Aona?
I should...do some cleaning...
Ugh. There's so little fabric, it makes me anxious... Criselda said it was cute, though.
Luarca says we should enjoy ourselves while we're here... but I wonder if Resna would wear one with me?
W-Welcome... I wonder if this is okay.
This goes here... and that goes there... Oh, I get it! So that's how it works...!
Ugh, it's so boring just waiting around... Maybe I should get some light exercise in.
Look, look at this outfit! Resna said it looks cute on me!
Ever since I was a kid, I've always wanted to meet the Star Messengers.
If I play my trumpet in this outfit... Yeah! I bet I can bring smiles to everyone's faces!
Hmm...? What kind of effect did this medicinal herb have again...?
This atelier is filled with so many memories.
Since starting this adventure, we've encountered so many things. And here we are, welcoming another new year.
Does this ceremonial kimono suit me? Isn't it a bit too fancy for me?
With renewed spirits, I pray for everyone's happiness... May this be a long and prosperous year.

Even though they're both ateliers, they're completely different!
I guess my atelier back home was a bit special though.
Listening to everyone's stories about their worlds... They're so different, it's crazy!
Ahh, waking up to a hot meal ready and waiting... That's true happiness right there.
El's ears feel so nice to touch... Ahh, it's like touching pure happiness!
Eek! Big sis is calling for me! I just know she's got a lecture waiting for me!
So many different people visit here. Talking with them really helps broaden my horizons and perspective.
Not enough hands to organize the documents? I'll help out if you need me.
Why does Rias always have to be so careless about herself...
Cleaning's done, laundry's done, breakfast is ready. Guess it's about time to wake Rias up...
El can be like that sometimes, but he was my very first friend. I'm grateful for that.
The book collection here is truly magnificent. I wonder if I might reorganize it to my liking...
This alchemy cauldron... I'd love to take my time examining its structure thoroughly...
To think I'd have the opportunity to demonstrate the new possibilities of man-made Apexi in this manner...
This has become a practical application in a direction I never initially anticipated, but that makes it all the more enjoyable.
Though I've left my position as a researcher with the Polar Night Alchemists, in spirit I remain a seeker of knowledge... heh.
Since we're here, maybe I should clean up a bit. Is it okay if I tidy this area?
Everyone really seems to enjoy reading books. I wonder if there are any books I could read too?
I was bedridden until just a little while ago. So I'm really happy that I can go on adventures now.
My brother has been pushing himself so hard for my sake. What can I do for him in return?
I'm still inexperienced as an adventurer, but someday I want to be able to help my brother.
This atelier is full of surprises. There's even more advanced equipment here than the Polar Night Alchemists had.
I'm grateful that you accepted me here.
I can travel with Tim like this now. Sometimes I still wonder if this isn't all just a dream.
We're adventurers now. It's not easy, but I'm grateful for these peaceful days.
Why does Tim always hide away whenever Nio comes by to deliver herbal tea?
This place that Saskia created... I'd like to examine it more closely.
It's bustling, but somehow calming. What a mysterious place.
There are so many wonderful girls here, I can't help but look around.
Resna and Valeria... Hehe, looks like there'll be something interesting to see.
Is there still more truth for these eyes to capture, I wonder?
Phew... Reading a book by myself is so relaxing. Right, Aona?
I should...do some cleaning...
My friends...Luarca and the others, and Criselda. I always thought it would just be the five of us...
A lot has happened, but... everyone from the Alchemist Party is still important to me...
I'm still not good at talking to people... But I think I've gotten a bit better than before.

Munya... This sweet is so delicious...
Hah. I accidentally got too relaxed again...!
This mountain of books... There seem to be many that would be useful references for my work as a supervisor.
Helping those in trouble and maintaining order in the Archipelago Federation. Being a supervisor is such a wonderful job~!
Hawaa... I overslept again today, so my work has piled up...

This sweet is incredibly delicious!
Eh, it was made by someone from another world!?
I can't motivate myself to do anything other than fighting... I'm so bored.
Can I sleep for a bit...? Just a little bit.
Yeah, I'm in perfect condition. I can head out anytime.
Come to think of it, I've made quite a lot more connections with people. It's very different from how things were a while ago.
Ugh... I want to move my body soon... I want to move!
What should I synthesize next...?
This atelier looks eccentric, but it's strangely calming.
Where should we go today? I should ask everyone about their plans too.
I need to maintain my tools regularly. They're useless if I can't use them when I need them.
Every day, there's so much to learn. I should properly review everything.
Hm hm hm~, hm hm hm♪
Maybe I should start cleaning soon. I'm itching to get started~

Staff, check! Notebook, check!
...All preparations complete!

Every day, there's so much to learn...
It's tough, but I'm really fulfilled!
The book I read last night was really interesting... Hehehe.
Hmm, which pie should I have today?
This isn't my atelier, so I need to be careful not to cause any explosions...
I need to properly maintain my staff. I can't do that after heading out.

I packed my pie for lunch, so now I just need to... Ah!
I think I forgot to wash the cooking utensils!

Coming to this world... Hah!
It couldn't be that Master did something, could it!?
In a way, is this place a hideout too?
Alchemy is fine, but I don't really like studying other things much...
Now then, what's the next plan? Since I came to this world, I need to have lots of adventures!
Hearing everyone's stories makes me want to visit their worlds too.
I don't get scolded because I don't have chores to help with at home... but that feels a bit unsatisfying in its own way...
This place is so cozy. I end up lounging around here all the time.
Exchanging information with skilled companions. It's actually pretty useful.
I wear this mask for work. It's the kind of job where you make enemies no matter what.
The odd-couple inspector duo is working hard again today. It's good to see them so lively.
I'm not good with strict stuff. Living freely is definitely the best way.
The quality of this atelier is truly commendable. I would very much like to have one in my own castle.
Oh my... I haven't seen this book before. May I borrow it for a while?
For the sake of the Kingdom of Lara, I cannot afford to waste a single day.
As one who stands above others, I cannot allow myself to neglect my studies.
Alchemy is the power to manifest one's desires. That is what captivated me.
...I've read almost all the books around here. Not that I can use alchemy, though.
I've found myself with a gap in my schedule... Now then, what should I do to fill the time?
These glasses are my important partner in handling intellectual matters. I must clean them properly.
It's good that everyone is enthusiastic, but... are you all getting proper sleep?
An organized and tidy space is more important than anything. Otherwise, my thoughts become scattered.
Hmm? This appears to need repair. Here, I'll take care of it.
The stories about order in the wanderers' worlds are quite interesting. It gives me much to consider regarding my own work.
Returning those who have strayed from the righteous path could be considered part of an inspector's mission.
I take pride in my work. Though it is by no means an easy path.
Educating subordinates is a superior's duty. I must ensure Tiny properly builds both confidence and achievements...
This is the wisdom of alchemy...! Every time I visit, my heart races with excitement!
I wonder if the day will come when I can understand these difficult texts...?
I came to the city to become an idol. I want to succeed!
Being in a unit is wonderful. Having comrades to work hard with has such a nice ring to it!
My ninja training has been helpful for my work as an idol.
I mustn't let my guard down even while waiting. I need to be ready to move at a moment's notice.
I don't have anything to do today... Maybe I'll kill some time by reading a book.
I never thought I'd be put in a cute-themed unit.

I think I'm more of a cool type than a cute type.
...I'm the cool one? W-Well, that's fine then.
With my genius, I could rise to the top as an idol.
This goes here... and this goes... Oh, that's right, I need to do it like this...!
Hmm, I'm bored just waiting around... Maybe I'll do some light exercise.
This outfit is so cute! I wonder if Resna would compliment me on it?
Johanna and Kimon are both super cute! We'd make an awesome unit together!
I wonder if Resna is working hard on her studies right now? I need to work hard too!
I should maintain my gun properly. Like my faith, it's something I truly believe in.
Miraculous arts using the stars' blessings... This place is also sacred, isn't it?
Each world must have its own different faiths. That's quite fascinating to me.
Everyone has their troubles. The people here must each be carrying their own burdens as well.
I'd like to have my gun modified through alchemy too. So I can send more demons to God's mercy.
Since I'm wearing such pretty clothes, I need to take proper care of my hair too.
This place feels almost like home now. I might end up getting too comfortable here.
These clothes might stand out a bit... No wait, maybe I'm being a little too self-conscious.
Now that I have more places to call home, I can work even harder and face forward! Something like that!
From now on, Heidi won't run away! Won't whine! Won't give up! Probably!
When I come here, I feel like I might stumble upon some delicious tea and sweets.
Wanderers are so interesting! I'd love to hear more stories about their original worlds and other things too.
When interesting things happen, each day really shines bright. I wonder what's going to happen today?
I'm actually pretty skilled as a merchant. Information gathering is my specialty♪
Alvina always reacts properly, so it's fun to tease her~
Ateliers are so relaxing, aren't they? Well, I might be too busy tidying up to actually relax.
The books here are really helpful for studying... Oh, where am I supposed to put this back when I'm done reading?
Hmm, where did I put that... Ugh, Plachta's going to scold me...
Meeting Plachta when I was a child... I realized that Plachta has always been Plachta, even back then.
To become a certified alchemist, there should be plenty I can do in this world too!
Come to think of it, I still have that book I borrowed. I should return it.
